metaDescription: Cancel your Acuity Scheduling subscription and disconnect it from your Squarespace site, with tips for handling billing correctly.
intro: If you're changing how you handle bookings or simply want to simplify your website, removing Acuity Scheduling from Squarespace starts with managing your Acuity account and subscription. This guide covers logging in, canceling billing, and making sure everything is settled cleanly.

steps.heading: Log in to Acuity Scheduling
steps.body: Go to the Acuity Scheduling website and click the login button, entering the email associated with your account, or using Continue with Google if it's linked.

steps.heading: Access your dashboard
steps.body: Once logged in, head to your Acuity dashboard where you manage all aspects of your scheduling setup.

steps.heading: Handle your subscription first
steps.body: In the billing section, cancel any active subscription tied to your account — this is a necessary step before removing Acuity from your Squarespace setup.

steps.heading: Confirm no active subscriptions remain
steps.body: Double-check that billing shows no active subscriptions if you're planning to fully part ways with Acuity.

steps.heading: Verify the change reflects in Squarespace
steps.body: Allow a few moments for the cancellation to register, then check your Squarespace scheduling settings to confirm the change.

faq.question: Do I need to cancel billing before removing Acuity?
faq.answer: Yes, handling your subscription in the billing section is a necessary first step before you can fully remove Acuity from your setup.

faq.question: How long does it take for changes to take effect?
faq.answer: Some actions take a moment to fully process, so allow a little time before assuming something didn't work.

faq.question: What if I'm logged into the wrong account?
faq.answer: Always double-check you're logged into the correct Acuity account tied to your Squarespace site to avoid confusion during the process.

faq.question: Will removing Acuity affect my other integrations, like Stripe or PayPal?
faq.answer: Since Acuity often connects to payment and calendar tools, review and unlink those integrations separately if you no longer need them.
